title: Ustaad Bhagat Singh Box Office Day 7: Film Struggles With ₹1.14 Cr, Week 1 Total Stalls at ₹65.74 Cr
text:
Hyderabad, India — March 26, 2026
The box office run of Ustaad Bhagat Singh is showing clear signs of slowdown, with collections dropping significantly by the end of its first week.
According to early trade estimates, the film earned ₹1.14 crore on Day 7, reflecting a steep decline in daily revenue. With this, the movie’s total collection stands at ₹65.74 crore after seven days in India.
Box Office Performance Overview
After opening with moderate expectations, Ustaad Bhagat Singh has struggled to maintain momentum at the ticket window. The sharp fall in weekday collections indicates weakening audience traction and limited repeat viewership.
Industry trackers suggest that the film has not been able to sustain the initial buzz, resulting in lower occupancy across key markets.
Week 1 Trend Analysis
Ustaad Bhagat Singh collected ₹1.14 crore on Day 7, taking its total India box office earnings to ₹65.74 crore in one week, signaling a significant slowdown in performance.
Market Impact & Industry Response
The underwhelming performance of the film has raised concerns among distributors and exhibitors. While the film featured Pawan Kalyan in a lead role, the box office numbers have not matched expectations.
Trade analysts note that performance trends like these may influence short-term investment decisions in upcoming projects. However, industry experts also emphasize that box office outcomes can vary widely based on content, competition, and audience reception.
FAQ Section
Q1. How much did Ustaad Bhagat Singh earn on Day 7?
The film earned ₹1.14 crore on its seventh day at the Indian box office.
Q2. What is the total collection of the film after one week?
The total India collection stands at ₹65.74 crore after 7 days.
Q3. Is Ustaad Bhagat Singh performing well at the box office?
The film has shown a declining trend, with collections dropping significantly by Day 7.
Q4. Who is the lead actor in the film?
The film stars Pawan Kalyan in the lead role.
